TARRASQUE SPAWN
CR 12

XP 19,200
N Huge magical beast
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+2 Dex, +6 armor, +6 natural)
hp 185 (14d10 +98)
Fort +17, Ref +11, Will +5; DR 5/epic; Immune ability damage, disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, petrification, poison, polymorph; SR 21

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +24 (2d8 +10) 2 claws +22 (2d6 +10)
Ranged 3 spines +16 (1d10 +10/x3)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 14, Con 26, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +14; CMB +18, CMD 30
Feats Awesome Blow, Blind-Fight, Bleeding Critical, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude
SQ Carapace

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Carapace (Su)

The tarrasque spawn’s scales deflect rays and magic missile spells, rendering the tarrasque immune to such effects. There is a 30% chance a deflected effect reflects back in full force at the caster; otherwise it is simply negated.

Spines (Ex)

The tarrasque spawn can loose a volley of three s pea r-like spines from its body as a standard action with a tos s of its head or a lash of its tail. Make an attack roll for each spine—all targets must be within 30 feet of each other. The spines have a range increment of 120 ft.

Frightful Presence (Su)

All creatures within 120 feet of the tarrasque spawn and are aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Will saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for i t, the creature is immune to the tarrasque spawn’s frightful presence for the next 24 hours.

The tarrasque spawn is hostile to all targets. It will not differentiate between the PCs and cultists. The cultists, for their part, will never willingly harm the spawn.
